product_purpose: Complete at most ten distinct, effect-confirmed ordinary donations per daily reset to the game's automatically selected HOT Alliance Tech.

postconditions: current Alliance Tech page and source are positively recognized
the game's automatically selected current HOT Tech is positively identified and rebound before every action
ordinary Donate control, numeric ordinary cost, game cost_affordable indicator, and displayed available attempts are fresh; no HUD resource census or wallet balance is required
zero currently available attempts are positively observed
the current observed timer or an explicit safe recheck policy controls deferral; no deadline is fabricated
canonical Home is positively recognized after a current no-attempt deferral
one ordinary-resource Donate action is currently enabled with a numeric cost and positive game affordability, separate from premium gem controls
remaining current-reset quota is positive and the current attempt count is positive
one separately bounded ordinary donation input is sent, never an unbounded press-and-hold
transport call increments only attempted-dispatch accounting and is not a committed action
one displayed attempt is consumed net of a positively observed 1800-second regeneration rollover; an unchanged count requires before/after countdown rollover and elapsed capture time
only this distinct attempt-confirmed effect increments committed_action_count and durable daily_committed_action_count; wallet debit and Tech progress are not gates
ranking, Tech progress, Bonus and reward multipliers never count as donations
confirmed action count is durably reset-scoped across restart
the next action rebinds the HOT target, numeric ordinary cost, game affordability, and displayed attempts
confirmed partial quota remains persisted and canonical Home is positively recognized
exactly ten actual distinct donations have positive current action effects
no Daily, ranking, or reward-point counter inspection is required
unresolved action effect is durably preserved and never counted as success
identical donation retry is denied
canonical Home is positively recognized

cost_quantity_requirements.notes: Each action requires the current exact ordinary-resource cost and balance. The reset quota is ten confirmed actions; per-action quantity is one.

cooldown_deferred_behavior: One attempt regenerates every 1800 seconds up to 20 stored attempts. Spend currently available attempts consecutively without a between-action wait. When none remain, use the currently observed timer or an explicit safe recheck policy; never fabricate a due time or alter the ten-action target.
bounded_recovery_behavior: Stop on changed HOT target, unknown numeric ordinary cost/affordability/attempts, red shortage, premium control, stale source, or unresolved effect. Preserve confirmed partial count and unresolved effects across restart, deny identical retries, and return only through recognized safe navigation.
evidence_requirements: Fresh current HOT Tech identity, ordinary Donate control, numeric ordinary cost, cost_affordable, displayed attempt count, and immediate-before source reference/hash for every action; no all-resource HUD census.

Current native effect evidence binds exactly one consumed displayed attempt net of positively observed regeneration, with immediate successor reference/hash. An unchanged count requires countdown rollover and elapsed capture time. Canonical Home is the route terminal, not resource-debit or Tech-progress proof.

Native outcomes distinguish donation_transport_calls from committed_action_count and durable daily_committed_action_count; availability_evidence and next_eligible_at are based only on current observation.
No ranking or reward-point counters, Daily screen, D02, or point attribution is used as action success evidence.

required_evidence: current production-route source, immediate-before, transport, immediate-after, semantic donation effect, and terminal Home bindings
ten distinct committed action effects with durable partial progress and no overshoot despite available stored attempts
attempt regeneration/cap behavior, consecutive available actions, current no-attempt deferral, and unknown-result no-retry

scenarios.notes: Product approval sets the ten-action envelope only; registration and runtime dispatch remain disabled pending native acceptance.

replay_fixture_requirements.notes: No live acceptance or execution is claimed by this product record or contract.

unsupported_or_manual_only_states: unknown or changed ordinary resource cost
resource boxes, refills, or forced reset
ranking points or reward-point counter as action count
transport calls counted as committed actions
repeated identical donation after unknown effect
